title: Paywall
body: You spent minutes on a survey about what you can change on yourself, typical survey like any other app but here you can’t use or test the app to see if this is really worth it with a subscription of 20€ a month. And a million users but only 44 ratings tells you everything you need to know.
author: Greeco21

title: Total Joke
body: I’ve spent 15 minutes for a survey I’m forced to take for the analytics and statistics thing they always do. Just so I can choose a plan afterwards. Total waste of time. And way too complicated. Deleted immediately obviously.
author: Sesto_Elemento
